meta.description: THE ONLY workflow allowed to call the Sendblue send endpoint. Every candidate message passes the full guard set (kill switches, per-record state, opt-out, consent, compliance, idempotency, messaging hours, rate limit, test mode) before sending. Stores only technical delivery/idempotency data.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ 'SELECT Id' + (JSON.parse($env.SF_FIELD_MAP_JSON || '{}').mappings ? Object.entries(JSON.parse($env.SF_FIELD_MAP_JSON).mappings).filter(([k, s]) => ['ai_enabled','human_takeover','sms_consent','sms_opt_out','wrong_number','last_inbound_date'].includes(k) && s.field !== 'UNMAPPED' && s.object === ($('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.record_ref || 'Lead:').split(':')[0]).map(([, s]) => ', ' + s.field).join('') : '') + ' FROM ' + ($('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.record_ref || 'Lead:x').split(':')[0] + " WHERE Id = '" + ($('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.record_ref || ':').split(':')[1] + "'" }}

options.$comment: Re-reads suppression state at send time. Skipped/failed => guard evaluation falls back to caller-provided record_state_json, and consent-required sends fail closed.
Recent rows are filtered in the guard node by created_at for the per-minute global rate limit.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { sent: false, blocked: true, failures: $json.verdict.failures, correlation_id: $json.correlation_id } }];

options.$comment: idempotency_key column UNIQUE — a duplicate dispatch attempt fails this insert and is dropped on the error branch. Sendblue webhook retries and workflow replays can never double-send.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const j = $('Evaluate All Send Guards').first().json; const body = { number: j.to_number, content: j.content, from_number: $env.SENDBLUE_FROM_NUMBER, status_callback: ($env.N8N_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL || '') + '/webhook/sendblue/status' }; if (j.seat_id) body[j.seat_param] = j.seat_id; return JSON.stringify(body); })() }}

options.$comment: seat param name configurable — ASSUMPTIONS A-05

parameters.url: ={{ $env.SF_INSTANCE_URL }}/services/data/{{ $env.SF_API_VERSION || 'v61.0' }}/sobjects/{{ ($('Evaluate All Send Guards').first().json.record_ref || 'Lead:').split(':')[0] }}/{{ ($('Evaluate All Send Guards').first().json.record_ref || ':').split(':')[1] }}
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const m = (JSON.parse($env.SF_FIELD_MAP_JSON || '{}').mappings || {}); const obj = ($('Evaluate All Send Guards').first().json.record_ref || 'Lead:').split(':')[0]; const s = m.last_outbound_date; if (!s || s.field === 'UNMAPPED' || s.object !== obj) return JSON.stringify({}); return JSON.stringify({ [s.field]: new Date().toISOString() }); })() }}

options.$comment: No-op when record_ref or last_outbound_date mapping absent.
